name: Tsukikadojima Vika
source:
President of the Handicrafts Club II. For some reason, students who join the Handicrafts Club II often disappear from the school after they graduate.

All of the club members, except Tsukikadojima Vika herself, have already graduated.

She has a peculiar aura about her and is seen as the school’s “big sister” figure.

[spoiler]She was found dead with her head missing the day before Shimoyuki Shihon died.[/spoiler]
translation:
President of the Handicrafts Club II. For some reason, students who join the Handicrafts Club II often disappear from the school after they graduate.

She has a peculiar aura about her and is seen as the school’s “big sister” figure.

[spoiler]She was found dead with her head missing the day before Shimoyuki Shihon died.[/spoiler]
